newsitem.title: UK: UK job prospects best for seven years - survey.
newsitem.headline: UK job prospects best for seven years - survey.

text.p: Job prospects in Britain over the next few months will be the best for seven years, according to a survey out on Monday.
One in five employers forecast an increase in jobs in the first three months of 1997, a poll of 2,155 employers by employment services group Manpower showed.
The most optimistic sectors are manufacturing and telecommunications although the building industry is also showing signs of increased confidence.
Employers in the south are most optimistic about prospects in the new year with the most pessimistic forecasts coming from the north-east.

"It is heartening to see the new year off to a good start," said Lilian Bennett, chairwoman of Manpower. "Apart from increased optimism over job prospects, there are also signs of a recovery in overall confidence and investment, particularly in training."
"One hopes that the uncertainty that a general election always brings does nothing to inhibit this so that we can maintain the momentum and avoid skill shortages."
British elections are due by May next year.
